source.subject: test: compare native NVFP4 Gate Up against Lt

purpose.question: Does the first admitted test-only M64xN256 pair-lookup native Gate/Up cell beat the selected zero-cuBLASLt-workspace direct-dequant plus cuBLASLt C512 pair under one process, one fixture, and one timing protocol?
purpose.answer: No. Native serial and dual schedules are both bitwise exact and resource/Graph clean, but reach only 0.633x to 0.639x of the best zero-cuBLASLt-workspace Lt pair in the paired blocks; that pair still reuses one 170-MiB BF16 dequant scratch.
purpose.decision: retain the cuBLASLt bridge as production; retain pair lookup only as a native development control; reset native work around whole-dataflow operand reuse

shape.weight_format: canonical packed NVFP4 E2M1 plus E4M3FN block-16 scales

environment.payload_scope: deterministic synthetic Gate and Up tensors from the common pair-screen fixture

protocol.lt_policy: screen selects the fastest successful zero-cuBLASLt-workspace heuristic for the ceiling comparison and reuses one 178257920-byte BF16 dequant scratch
protocol.production_context_boundary: the production context uses its runtime successful heuristic contract rather than this screen's timing-ranked identity; observed index-0 versus selected-index-2 Lt time differs by about 0.2%, far below the native rejection gap

correctness_graph_and_resources.full_candidate_invalid_contract: 23/23 remains covered by the dedicated native candidate screen

native_serial_vs_native_dual.engineering_interpretation: the 0.2197% paired gain is reproducible in this process but too small to justify a production scheduling decision

prior_native_internal_admission.scope: synthetic native M64xN256 A-only-CA control versus pair lookup, not versus Lt
prior_native_internal_admission.interpretation: pair lookup remains a real native-internal improvement, but the stricter Lt comparison supersedes it for production selection

causal_boundary.current_native_problem: M64 ownership still presents compressed B and scales across eight M tiles and A across 68 N tiles; pair lookup changes decode instruction pressure but not those repetitions
causal_boundary.dual_stream_result: Gate/Up concurrency recovers only about 0.2% in the direct paired screen
causal_boundary.synthetic_ncu_boundary: the existing pair-lookup NCU payload is synthetic; no real-checkpoint shared-wavefront or bank-distribution production claim is made
causal_boundary.architecture_action: model Gate/Up, long-K Down, and the FP8 projection families separately before implementing the next complete cell
